description: Marionnet is provided by Marionnet project. Marionnet is a virtual network laboratory for defining and running Ethernet networks on one GNU/Linux host. It represents computers, routers, switches, hubs and cables and can connect the virtual network to the host network. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Cost and access terms require confirmation with the provider. No live-network connection or installation was performed. Potential simulation use: Teach and test network configuration through reproducible virtual topologies.
